value.rationale: The three rules are a natural, explicitly open list of two-to-one cases in the first small-diameter census of LEO criteria. Their complete two-class classification under shift-commuting conjugacy and distinguishing temporal-period signature reduce three seemingly separate research decisions to at most two. The factorization gives a concrete reusable connection between reversible local transformations and binary differences; the negative comparison needs a genuinely different exact periodic invariant. The claim is a complete classification of a mathematically selected trio, not an arbitrary numeric benchmark or a routine implementation of previously stated equivalences.
